# Fonts

## `FontInfo`

```python
FontInfo(
    xref: int | None,
    names: tuple[str, ...],
    base_font: str,
    subtype: str,
    encoding: str,
    program: str | None,
    subset: bool,
    forms: tuple[int, ...],
    _font: Dictionary,
)
```

One font dictionary that a page's resources name, from `Page.fonts`.

## `FontProgram`

```python
FontProgram(type: str, data: bytes)
```

An embedded font program, from `Document.font_program`.

## `SubsetFont`

```python
SubsetFont(
    xref: int,
    name: str,
    glyphs: int,
    kept: int,
    size_before: int,
    size_after: int,
)
```

One font program that `Document.subset_fonts` subset.
